decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, so its value is still highly uncertain, but as a niche maritime project option it costs little to keep open while naval demand resolves.

The medical examination light builds on existing lighting competence and has its own page, and its prospects in a regulated adjacent market are still unresolved, so keeping this low-cost option open is preferable to early abandonment.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's industrial customer base, certified manufacturing and testing facilities, so the option shows enough value to justify continued commitment.
The designer task light is a relaunch of a popular product close to the core offer, which leaves little uncertainty and requires little additional cost to keep on the market.
